title: Thai basil turkey with green beans
summary: Turkey mince stir-fried with green beans, chilli and a lot of basil, in the style of pad kra pao, with a small bowl of rice.

ingredients.prepNote: leaves, plus a few to finish

steps.instruction: Start the rice in the water with a pinch of salt. Chop the garlic and chilli together so they are ready to hit a hot pan.
Heat the oil until it is very hot and fry the garlic and chilli for a few seconds, just until fragrant.
Add the turkey and break it up. Fry until it browns in places, then add the green beans and pepper.
steps.tip: Basil mince should have a few crispy edges. Don't stew it in liquid.

steps.instruction: Splash in the tamari and fish sauce, toss for a minute, then kill the heat and stir through the basil and lime juice. Serve with the rice and the extra basil leaves.

image.alt: Thai basil mince with green beans and rice
